offering_description.value: Provides aviation aftermarket services to commercial airlines, governments and defense customers. This includes aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul, parts supply and distribution, component repair, and mobility and expeditionary equipment. Delivered through hangars, repair shops, distribution centers and field teams.

primary_products.value: aircraft parts and components; engineered pallets and shelters for military mobility; new and used aircraft parts; landing gear and component repairs

primary_services.value: aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul; parts supply chain and distribution; component repair and engineering; airlift and flight services; fleet management and trading

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial airlines, cargo carriers, aircraft lessors and original equipment manufacturers; B2G: US Department of Defense, other US government agencies and foreign governments

end_markets.value: commercial aviation; defense and military aviation; government aviation

revenue_model.value: service fees: aircraft maintenance, repair, overhaul and component repair; product sales: aircraft parts and engineered mobility systems; project or contract: long-term government programs and airlift contracts, performance-based logistics
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: maintenance, repair and overhaul using purchased parts, serving airlines and governments; distributor: buys and distributes aircraft parts from manufacturers to airlines and military customers; OEM / manufacturer: builds engineered pallets and shelters for military customers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia, Middle East and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: MRO, parts supply, component repair, airlift and mobility products for aviation customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving airlines, defense agencies and government contract awards; own locations: hangars, repair facilities and distribution centers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FAA and EASA repair station certifications, defense contracting rules, export controls (ITAR) and government procurement regulations
